COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than

The manufacturer brochure describes a Baihetan intake trash-rack application. This does not establish suitability for every rack or replacement of fixed debris-raking machinery.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the A-80.

How is the A-80 controlled?

The manufacturer lists two control modes: teleoperation and supervised semi-autonomous operation. It switches between swimming and crawling, and cleans with a cavitation water jet without contact or with an interchangeable brush.

Can it do more than trash-rack cleaning?

The manufacturer’s animation also shows gate leak detection and sealing and gate-slot obstacle clearing. Treat these as concepts to discuss with the manufacturer; each needs its own tools, procedure and site review.
